clauses.name: Bloatuba
clauses.printedParagraph: When the Bloatuba enters the field, you may Chain from your hand. A target opponent reveals a number of cards from the top of the deck equal to the base power of the Chained manifestation. If they can, the opponent chooses and puts into stalemate a manifestation among those cards, then you reorder the remaining cards and the opponent puts them at the bottom of their deck in the order established by you.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Offer the optional entry Chain. Reveal top cards equal to the Chained Manifestation’s printed base power. The opponent puts one revealed Manifestation into Stalemate if possible; the controller orders every remaining occurrence on the bottom. Respect Deck-exit replacements, choice actors, stale snapshots and unchanged in-Deck identities.

clauses.name: Expansive Ponderer
clauses.printedParagraph: When the Expansive Ponderer enters the field, you can Chain from your hand. Look at a number of cards from the top of the deck equal to the base power of the Chained manifestation. Choose and put one card among them into your hand, then distribute any number of the others on the top and bottom of the deck in any order.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Offer the optional entry Chain; privately inspect top cards equal to the Chained Manifestation’s base power. Put exactly one into Hand, then distribute every other occurrence between top and bottom in any order. This is a put, not a draw; preserve actual movement replacements and exact multiplicities.
